$schema_note: Single source-of-truth table of every numeric limit/threshold used across GARUN -- referenced by validation/constraints.json, dashboard/cards.json status_thresholds, and optimization/constraints.json. If a limit changes, update it here first, then propagate to mission.py's CONSTRAINTS dict (the actual code-level source of truth) and the referencing config files.

soc_max.source: Li-ion cell chemistry -- high-SoC lithium-plating protection

cruise_power_kw_max.source: PS1 baseline engine rating (design choice, not a PS1-mandated ceiling itself)

cruise_power_margin_factor.source: main.py design choice -- allows modest electric-assist contribution at cruise

battery_specific_energy_wh_per_kg.source: Representative aerospace-grade NMC pack figure (Battery University BU-205 + eVTOL/UAV sizing literature)
battery_specific_energy_wh_per_kg.confidence: Medium -- literature representative value, not a specific cited cell datasheet

turboshaft_sfc_kg_per_kwh.source: Representative small-turboshaft cruise SFC, broadly consistent with PT6A-series published figures
turboshaft_sfc_kg_per_kwh.confidence: Low-Medium -- constant approximation, not a load-dependent BSFC map (see warnings.json :: bsfc_constant_not_map)

structural_weight_fraction.confidence: Low -- see blueprint Appendix A, listed there as ~0.29 from historical composite UAV data; this codebase currently uses 0.35 -- RECONCILE before final submission

weight_growth_margin_recommended.code_ref: not yet implemented -- see warnings.json :: no_weight_growth_margin

known_inconsistency.detail: This file's structural_weight_fraction (0.35) does not match the blueprint's Appendix A cited value (~0.29 from historical composite UAV data). One of these needs to be corrected -- resolve before final submission, since a judge could reasonably cross-check the report against the blueprint's own assumptions appendix.

source: physics.py, aircraft.py, mission.py, main.py; cross-referenced against GARUN_Engineering_Blueprint.md Appendix A
